run_training_benchmark: run a training benchmark comparing fp32 baseline against bf16 candidate settings and return fidelity metrics
run_benchmark_runner: run the TrainingBenchmarkRunner to benchmark training throughput and save a JSON report to the results directory
create_benchmark_callback: create a BenchmarkTrainCallback to capture per-step losses, gradient norms, and step times during training
review_benchmark_result: review the TrainingBenchmarkResult dataclass to understand fidelity and throughput metrics from a benchmark run
test_run_single: test the _run_single function to execute a single training session with Hydra config overrides and return pickled results
